title: Pharmacy Sales & Profitability Dashboard
summary: Power BI dashboard on a pharmacy sales and profitability dataset, covering revenue and profit trends, category performance, store size and geographic breakdowns.
problem: A pharmacy sales dataset needed to become a clear view of where revenue and profit come from.
objective: Show revenue and profit trends, category performance, and differences by store size and location.
approach: Built a two-page Power BI report: an Overview page and a Sales & Profitability page.
process: Explored the dataset and defined the questions the report should answer
Built the Overview page for headline trends
Built the Sales & Profitability page for category, store size and geographic breakdowns
